import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()/"benchmark_tools/results"
fixed=json.loads((root/"native_qfo_three_cell_strata_20261007_v1/report.json").read_text())
distance=json.loads((root/"swiss_model_divergence_strata_20261007_v1/report.json").read_text())
mismatches=[]
for name,doc in (("fixed",fixed),("distance",distance)):
    for row in doc["rows"]:
        suite=row.get("suite","model_distance")
        members=doc["bins"][row["stratum"]] if name=="distance" else doc["bins"][suite][row["stratum"]]
        expected=dict(families=len(members),family_members=members,status="descriptive" if members else "empty_bin",
            prediction_semantics="resolved_native_pairs" if row["cell"].endswith("r1") else "group_clique")
        differences={key:dict(retained=row[key],new_consumer_expected=value) for key,value in expected.items() if row[key]!=value}
        if differences:
            mismatches.append(dict(source=name,suite=suite,cell=row["cell"],stratum=row["stratum"],differences=differences))
output=root/"native_qfo_four_cell_strata_20261009_v1"
print(json.dumps(dict(status="retained_metadata_only_diagnosis",mismatches=mismatches,
    selected_projection_recomputed=False,output_exists=output.exists()),allow_nan=False))
